'''House Knylenn''', or the '''Knylenn family''', was one of the ruling families of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==History==
The Knylenns were primary rivals of the [[House Kuat|Kuat family]] and attempted to usurp their power by overturning the [[Inheritance Exemption]]. The confrontation came to a head when [[Khoss of Knylenn]] arranged his elder's death, keeping the man on a life-support system and ensuring his own rule. However, he was exposed by [[Kuat (person)|Kuat]] [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|of Kuat]] and [[Kodir of Kuhlvult]].
